name: SWD/JTAG programmer-debugger
description: USB-connected debug probe with level-shifted SWD/JTAG, target power with current limit and target-voltage sensing.
electrical_characteristics: Level shifters referenced to the target VREF
Series resistors and ESD on target pins
USB full/high speed to the host
critical_electrical_constraints: Target VREF sense before driving any pin
placement_rules: Target connector with level shifters and protection next to it
USB interface at the opposite edge
routing_rules: Target signals short with series resistors; ground pins adjacent to signals on the target connector
Pogo-pin fixture nets routed to the pin field with matched lengths for clocks
copper_ground_requirements: Ground plane under the target interface
thermal_considerations: Bench supplies: pass element heatsinking at full load
emi_emc_considerations: Shielded USB; ground return on every ribbon cable pair
protection_requirements: Series resistors and TVS on every target pin; current-limited target power
verification_requirements: Target voltage range declared; level shifter direction and limits recorded
manufacturing_constraints: Pogo pins and keyed connectors; gold finish on contact pads
unsupported_conditions: Driving target pins at 3.3 V without sensing the target voltage
